definitions.credit: Per-process host elapsed launch windows; sums are not exclusive GPU time
definitions.gate_attribution: Includes initial-zero-credit startup; compare phase100 diagnostic pilot before attributing gates to phase reductions
definitions.bank: Maximum token interval is conservative and includes CPU/gate time; bank exceedance is diagnostic, never an exclusion
definitions.ownership: Freshness coverage under the existing 15-second watcher guard; this is periodic observation, not an ownership lock
definitions.final_debt: Final runtime snapshot debt and worker completion-snapshot debt are distinct; completion does not await debt repayment
